notes: the leading «1» is the report number, not part of the chain; «ره» and «(ع)» are honorifics: left out
«أبي» is a bare relation (the compiler's father) co-transmitting with «جماعة» (unnamed); «بعض رجاله» is an unnamed gap
«عن أبي عبد الله (ع) قال» : the Imam written after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling)
